what_it_is: pnpm monorepo for akerbrygge.no, the Aker Brygge waterfront district site: Next.js marketing/booking app (apps/web) plus Sanity v3 studio, with the pre-migration Next site still present in top-level web/ and studio/ dirs. Ships with a serious engineering apparatus: docs/adr, docs/cutover and docs/migration plans, e2e tests, bundle budgets, and Lighthouse CI configs (desktop + mobile).
role_why: 72% of all commits across four identities; his biggest commits are structural — hero/brand-token overhaul (fbd23bf6e, 59 files, +3488), vendored Studio Pro fonts closing ADR-0022 (67f2b6988), CSP-safe self-hosted dev tooling (fb573b15b) — plus the ADR/cutover documentation regime.
hardest_problems: Legacy-site-to-monorepo migration run through written ADRs, cutover checklists and an integrations inventory (Akerbrygge/docs/adr, docs/cutover, docs/integrations-inventory.md)
Mobile hero carousel + shared brand token system landed as one coherent 59-file change (fbd23bf6e)
Design-fidelity mobile sliders against Figma specs — center-snap, edge fades, tap-to-focus (ff688b182, 3460eaf51, 6e9c53dda)
grade_why: Frikk-led, currently live, high-profile Oslo client, and the repo demonstrates process maturity (ADRs, budgets, e2e) not just features.

what_it_is: Gatsby + Sanity marketing site for Kronprinsparets Fond (the Crown Prince couple's foundation), deployed on Netlify with a pageBuilding section system. Tobias-built 2020; Frikk did targeted maintenance and features 2024-2026.
role_why: 15% of commits; his biggest are the Mailchimp newsletter signup via Netlify Function (a1aa89b, +541) and image CDN/cost optimization (4058297).
hardest_problems: Newsletter signup wired through a Netlify Function to Mailchimp without a backend (commit a1aa89b, netlify/ dir)
Sanity image pipeline tuning for CDN cost and quality (4058297, cd4b847)
grade_why: Recognizable client name but Frikk's footprint is maintenance-scale; the interesting successor work lives in the monorepo.

what_it_is: Turborepo Frikk built solo in 2026 as the modern successor to the FLYT Gatsby stack: Next.js apps flyt-idrett and flyt-programmet plus a Sanity studio and shared ui/newsletter packages. flyt-idrett includes a diploma generator — programmatic SVG scallop frames, sticker sheets, vectorized FLYT logo, printable output — iterated through dozens of visual-precision commits.
role_why: 100% of 144 commits under five Frikk identities; remote is his personal GitHub.
hardest_problems: Programmatic SVG diploma rendering: scallop band geometry iterated to print quality (f635b064, e5c8f69a, c1314cdf in apps/flyt-idrett)
Sanity-editable newsletter section shared across two apps and the studio schema (bb721a42, packages/newsletter)
Vector logo + 9x resolution asset pipeline for print (283d2983)
grade_why: Solo-built, live, and the diploma generator is genuinely distinctive work — but it is a young repo (6 months) serving a niche internal tool.

what_it_is: Sanity v2 studio serving both the KPPF and FLYT Gatsby sites — schemas, desk structure, Netlify deploy dashboard. Essentially frozen since 2020 apart from Frikk's 2026 newsletter-section schema addition.
role_why: 2 of 19 commits; the substantive one adds the newsletterSection schema across both desks (4ad609b, +163).
hardest_problems: Nothing hard here — schema plumbing supporting the two Gatsby sites (schemas/kppf/documents/newsletterSection.js)
grade_why: Support scaffolding for the KPPF/FLYT sites; no standalone story.

what_it_is: Gatsby + Sanity site for the FLYT youth program (a KPPF program), Netlify-hosted, sibling of Kronprinsparets-fond. Frikk's 2025-2026 commits added a PDF-gating registration modal, fixed a leaked Sanity token, and the Mailchimp newsletter.

what_it_is: Gatsby + Sanity site for Oslobukta, the Bjorvika harbour district: event listings ('Hva skjer'), restaurant guide, Mapbox map, member popup with access-code input, Plausible analytics. Kult Byra project where Frikk was the clear second engineer.

Members-only popup gated by code input (c814c24, react-code-input)
Mapbox-driven district map integrated with Sanity content (mapbox-gl/react-map-gl in package.json)

what_it_is: Next.js + Sanity site for the Unge Venstre political youth party (Kult Byra project) with a Lerna-managed embedded studio. Built entirely by Vilde, Sigurd and Georg; sits on this machine as a reference clone from the Kult era.

what_it_is: Production e-commerce + corporate platform for aquatiq.com (food-safety industry): Next.js frontend, Shopify commerce backend, Sanity CMS, Clerk-authenticated admin/sales area, and ~20 Google Cloud Functions doing order sync, stock, discounts and course-participant handling. Multi-market ([market] routing, i18n).
role_why: ~8% of a large team codebase (#4-5 author); his commits concentrate on Algolia search indexing (webhook b56919ac, +322), the sitemap generation saga, a Sanity order-table plugin for course orders/participants, and the admin FailedOrdersPage.
hardest_problems: Algolia index kept in sync via webhook against Shopify/Sanity data (commit b56919ac)
Custom order-table Sanity plugin: course orders, dates, participants as studio tables (schema/order-table-plugin/components/DocumentTables/)
Failed-order recovery UI for the admin area (components/Pages/Admin/FailedOrdersPage/)
grade_why: Real production commerce integration work on a live multi-team platform — good dossier material even though Frikk was not a lead.

what_it_is: Turborepo for Gyldendal (major Norwegian publisher): gyldendal.no web app, Sanity studio, api and docs apps, plus packages including the Kobber design-system UI library and a Relewise search/recommendations integration. Frikk's employer repo, worked under his gyldendal.no identity.
role_why: #2 human author (179 commits); his file-focus is a self-contained Sanity DAM plugin (search, folder cache, asset preview, browse API) and the Surface/Interactive Button/Badge architecture refactor in packages/ui, including a written migration analysis (89465e28).
hardest_problems: Built a Sanity DAM (digital asset management) plugin: search API, folder caching, asset preview, metadata retrieval (apps/studio/src/lib/sanity/lib/plugins/dam/, commit 25af0e1d)
Design-system Button re-architecture using CSS cascade + tone inversion for automatic contrast, with a documented migration plan (commits a172c69f, 361fe7fb, 89465e28, e58576b8)
Monorepo-wide consolidation of Button usage into @packages/ui (82760480, 34 files)
grade_why: Named-brand employer, live at gyldendal.no, and Frikk owns two coherent, defensible systems in it: the DAM plugin and the design-system button architecture.

what_it_is: Customized Shopify Horizon theme for the PWDR Wear store; commit volume is dominated by shopify[bot] theme-editor syncs, with Henrik Smith as the main theme developer. Custom features documented in-repo: accordion filters, sticky add-to-cart, core theme modifications.

evidence: bot syncs through 2026-07 imply a live store
grade_why: One good Liquid feature on a live store; too thin for more.

what_it_is: B2B sample/order app for Polyflor (flooring): authenticated customers fill a shipping form that creates tickets in an external CRM (Bruno API collection in apis-collections/ shows company/user/token endpoints) and sends react-email order confirmations. Next.js with next-auth, Sanity for product data, hot-swappable ticket delivery path.
role_why: 61% of commits and the architecture-bearing ones are his: client-side auth middleware + login + order-result flow (edf8445, +901), ticket pipeline hardening and hot-swap sending (09738fa, cc26be4), CompanyNumber safeguards (605862b).
hardest_problems: Auth middleware and login gating for a B2B audience without a heavyweight backend (edf8445, src/middleware.ts)
Resilient ticket creation + email pipeline with explicit failure surfacing and a hot-swap send path (09738fa, ff9f860, ticket-utils)
Reverse-engineering the CRM API into Bruno collections for tokens, companies and users (apis-collections/)
grade_why: Frikk-led line-of-business app with real integration work (CRM tickets, auth, email), still maintained as of 2026-05.
